name: External Investigation Status Reason 1 Code
definition: Specifies the reason for the investigation status, as published in an external investigation status reason code set.|External code sets can be downloaded from www.iso20022.org.

AGNT.name: Incorrect Agent Or Party
AGNT.definition: Request message has been directed at an incorrect agent or party.

DU01.name: Duplicate Request
DU01.definition: Request message is duplicate, duplicate request message is rejected.

NARR.name: Narrative
NARR.definition: See ResponseData element for additional information.

FTNA.name: Investigation Request Forwarded To Agent Or Party
FTNA.definition: Request message forwarded to another agent or party, these may be indicated in NextResponder element.

CAPR.name: Closed As Per Request
CAPR.definition: Investigation closed as per the request message.

CACR.name: Closed As Cancellation Request Sent
CACR.definition: Investigation closed as cancellation request for underlying transaction has been sent.

INPO.name: In Progress
INPO.definition: Collation of response data is still ongoing.

ARDT.name: Already Returned
ARDT.definition: Investigation request not accepted as the transaction has already been returned.

LEGL.name: Legal Decision
LEGL.definition: Reported when the request cannot be accepted because of regulatory rules.

INIT.name: Incorrect Investigation Type
INIT.definition: Incorrect investigation type used in request message.

PARE.name: Partial Response
PARE.definition: Response message partially addresses the request, a further response message will follow.

NOAD.name: No Additional Information Available
NOAD.definition: No additional information in relation to the request can be provided.

G004.name: Waiting For Cover
G004.definition: Indicates that the credit claim non receipt investigation is pending as the cover creditor is waiting for the credit of the cover.

CMPI.name: Correction Made As Per Inquiry
CMPI.definition: Is related to a Correction Made as Per Inquiry procedure for investigation status Closed (CLSD).
